grades.quote: begin_op (4702) waits until the logging system is not currently committing, and until there is enough unreserved log space to hold the writes from this call.
grades.reason: States directly the two conditions under which begin_op waits: a commit is in progress, or there isn't enough unreserved log space. It also explains how log.outstanding and MAXOPBLOCKS drive the space reservation.
